title: Support Visits, Remote Support and Queue Handling Included with Each Circle Tier
content:
## Support included with a Northbeam Circle Membership

| Tier | Support visits included per year | Remote support included | Priority queue | Named account manager |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0 | no | no | no |
| Circle Plus Annual | 1 | yes | no | no |
| Circle Total Annual | 3 | yes | yes | no |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 4 | yes | yes | no |
| Circle Business Pro | 8 | yes | yes | yes |
| Circle Business Elite | 30 | yes | yes | yes |

The visit figure is the on-site or bench support visits included each membership year. Remote support,
where included, covers unlimited remote support sessions. The priority queue entry records whether calls
on the tier are routed to the priority queue. The account manager entry records whether a named account
manager is assigned to the membership.

## Points of judgement at the counter

*Which tiers include no visit at all?* Circle Free Membership, at 0 visits, is the only tier including
none; Circle Plus Annual includes 1, Circle Total Annual 3, Circle Total Household Annual 4, Circle
Business Pro 8 and Circle Business Elite 30.

*Which tiers carry a named account manager?* Circle Business Pro and Circle Business Elite carry one;
the four consumer tiers do not. The priority queue begins one step earlier, at Circle Total Annual, so a
household member on Circle Total Annual reaches the priority queue without a named manager. Remote
support is included on every tier except Circle Free Membership.
